description:
SAFE RIDING MODE: The Flyer kids electric bike features adjustable 2-speed options(low 4mph/6kmh and high 8mph/12kmh), to avoid accidentally switching to the second level, it needs to be pressed the button 4 times to switch. This ensures safety and reliability and allows kids to control their speed effortlessly. Electric bike is fully powered by electricity and offers Kids can effortlessly start the electric balance bike with just a gentle push, making it perfect for beginners.
ELECTRIC BIKE CONFIGURATION: The Flyer electric bike comes equipped with a 120W rear motor, reaching speeds of up to 15 km/h(Peak), it provides kids ages 3-6 with safe and powerful speed to easily negotiate obstacles in parks and dirt, ensuring your kids enjoy thrilling rides. The battery is 22V 3.2Ah, with a capacity of up to 3200 mah, kids can easily once ride it for 15km. The Charging time is only 4-6 hours, and it can be fully charged in less than one night.
COMPLETE & SECURE CONFIGURATION: Safety is essential with the kids electric balance bike. The Flyer 12" inflatable tires provide a comfortable riding experience, whether on pavement, dirt, or grass. As kids grow quickly, the adjustable seat height from 15'' to 17.7'' ensures kids can stop the bike with their feet. The Flyer is equipped with 2 braking methoda-reliable e-brake system and traditional brake pad braking method, all-round ensure the safety of children while riding.
SAFE & STURDY FRAME: The Flyer's frame is made of aluminum alloy, which is lighter and stronger than other iron or steel frames balance bike. It weighs 15.4 lbs, so kids can easily push it without getting crushed by it. Its maximum carrying capacity is 110 lbs, making it more tolerant of kid's weight!
FUN & UNIQUE CUSTOMIZATION: The Flyer kids electric bike have multiple optional accessories such as race plates with customizable numbers, training wheels, unicorn/dinosaur projector lights (Give away free), parking racks, kneepad sets, unicorn/dinosaur helmets and so on. These wonderful accessory ideas not only improve the safety of children's riding, but also increase their interest in exercise!
